tests.name: load_view_valid_integer_token_in_float_node_rejected
tests.intent: Probe if json_document::load with image_check::full correctly rejects an image where a float node covers an integer token that fits 64 bits.

tests.name: load_view_true_float_token_accepted
tests.intent: Probe if json_document::load with image_check::full successfully accepts a float node whose token actually contains a decimal fraction.

tests.name: load_view_exponent_float_token_accepted
tests.intent: Probe if json_document::load with image_check::full successfully accepts a float node whose token contains an exponent indicator.

tests.name: load_view_overflow_integer_token_float_node_accepted
tests.intent: Probe if json_document::load with image_check::full accepts a float node over an integer token that exceeds 64 bits and thus truly represents a float.

tests.name: load_view_negative_boundary_int_fits
tests.intent: Probe image check behavior on a negative integer token fitting inside signed 64-bit lower bound.

tests.name: load_view_minimal_check_mode
tests.intent: Probe if image_check::none bypasses the strict checks for mismatching float tokens and loaded integer bounds.

tests.name: load_view_basic_json_document_create
tests.intent: Probe basic construction and round-trip serialization using json_document API.

tests.name: load_view_integer_twenty_digits_exceed
tests.intent: Probe image loading with an integer token of 20 digits exceeding 18446744073709551615.

tests.name: load_view_negative_nineteen_digits_fit
tests.intent: Probe a negative 19-digit integer token within the limits of signed 64-bit integer values.

tests.name: load_view_negative_nineteen_digits_overflow
tests.intent: Probe a negative 19-digit integer token exceeding the lower bound of signed 64-bit integers.
